title: POS System
description: Learn how to use the Point of Sale (POS) system for in-store sales, inventory management, and offline transactions.
content:
POS System

The Point of Sale (POS) system allows you to process in-store sales, manage inventory in real-time, and handle offline transactions alongside your online store.

POS Overview

The POS system provides:

  • In-store checkout
  • Real-time inventory sync
  • Multiple payment methods
  • Receipt printing
  • Transaction history
  • Sales reporting

Accessing POS

Navigate to POS in your dashboard to access the POS interface.

POS Interface

The POS interface includes:

  • Product search and selection
  • Cart management
  • Customer selection
  • Payment processing
  • Receipt generation

Processing a Sale

Step 1: Add Products

Search and add products to the cart using the product search or barcode scanner.

Step 2: Select Customer (Optional)

Select an existing customer or create a new one for the transaction.

Step 3: Apply Discounts

Apply any discounts, coupons, or promotions if applicable.

Step 4: Process Payment

Select payment method and process the payment:

  • Cash
  • Credit/Debit card
  • Digital wallet
  • Store credit

Step 5: Complete Transaction

Complete the sale and print receipt. Inventory is automatically updated.

Payment Methods

Accept various payment methods:

  • Cash
  • Credit/Debit cards
  • Digital wallets
  • Store credit
  • Gift cards
  • Split payments

Inventory Management

POS integrates with inventory:

  • Real-time stock updates
  • Low stock alerts
  • Out of stock notifications
  • Inventory adjustments

Receipts

Generate and print receipts:

  • Automatic receipt generation
  • Email receipts
  • Print receipts
  • Receipt templates
  • Custom receipt fields

Transaction Management

Manage POS transactions:

  • View transaction history
  • Search transactions
  • View transaction details
  • Process refunds
  • Void transactions

POS Settings

Configure POS settings:

  • Receipt printer settings
  • Barcode scanner setup
  • Payment method configuration
  • Tax settings
  • Discount settings

Reporting

POS reporting includes:

  • Daily sales reports
  • Transaction summaries
  • Payment method breakdown
  • Product sales reports
  • Staff performance

Best Practices

  • Train staff on POS system
  • Keep inventory synced
  • Process transactions promptly
  • Review transactions regularly
  • Backup transaction data
  • Secure POS access
